title.narrative: AU-EU Skills for Youth Employability- SIFA Financial Facility Innovation Window

description.narrative: The Action is part of the AU-EU Skills for Youth Employability Programme and the AUC and AUDA-NEPAD ¿ the Skills Initiative for Africa (SIFA). The action aims at improving occupational prospects of young Africans through the support of job-oriented skills programme. The action will provide financing to innovative VET projects that will be selected through call for proposals under the Financing Facility of SIFA to be launched by AUDA-NEPAD and KfW.
